browser.title: Sign in directly with GM
browser.description: Open your browser's Network panel and enable Preserve log, then open [GM sign-in]({url}) in that same tab and complete sign-in and MFA. Select the final 302 request to custlogin.gm.com. Under Response Headers, copy the Location header beginning msauth.com.gm.mychevrolet://auth (not the HTTPS request URL) and paste its full value here. Close the Network panel when done.

token_import.title: Import GM identity tokens
token_import.description: Paste a Microsoft refresh token or the contents of a local microsoft_tokens.json obtained from this GM client. Home Assistant will validate it directly with GM.

data.tokens: Refresh token or Microsoft token JSON

retry_discovery.title: Retry vehicle discovery
retry_discovery.description: GM did not return the vehicle list. Wait for service or throttling to recover, then retry with your current sign-in.

native.title: Sign in to GM in Home Assistant
native.description: Experimental support for GM password sign-in with an authenticator app. Home Assistant sends your credentials directly to GM and does not save your password. If GM requires a browser or a different verification method, use browser sign-in instead.

mfa.title: Verify your GM sign-in
mfa.description: Enter the current six-digit code from your authenticator app within three minutes. Do not enter its setup key.

native_unavailable.title: GM requires browser sign-in
native_unavailable.description: GM blocked the native request, the connection failed, or this sign-in journey is not supported. Continue with browser sign-in or import tokens. Native sign-in supports authenticator codes; email and SMS verification are not supported yet.

error.invalid_auth: GM authorization was rejected, invalid or expired. Start a new sign-in or obtain a fresh token.
error.cannot_connect: The integration could not complete the request. Try again.
error.select_vehicles: Select at least one available vehicle.
error.invalid_mfa: The code was rejected or the sign-in expired. Try a current code, or close setup and start again.

abort.already_configured: This account or vehicle is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the GM account associated with the configured vehicles.
abort.authorization_expired: GM authorization expired. Start a fresh sign-in.

data_description.scan_interval: GM limits vary by vehicle and subscription. Default 30 minutes, minimum 15.
data_description.remote_controls: Requires advertised OnStar command access. Commands that require a PIN or privileged session stay disabled.
